node.label: sea-blue histiocyte syndrome
node.definition: A rare, inherited or acquired syndrome characterized by the presence of histiocytes in the bone marrow which contain granules stained blue with hematoxylin-eosin stain, mild thrombocytopenia and purpura, and splenomegaly.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
